issues.title: Azure / federated accounts offered local password changes
issues.problem: A retained local credential could expose password controls even when identity management came from the external provider.
issues.fix: Remove password controls and hints for externally managed identities. Server-side current-user changes and administrator resets require a locally managed identity.

issues.title: Ordinary users saw API tokens and active-session management
issues.problem: The personal sidebar and security page exposed management controls that product feedback requested to restrict to administrators.
issues.fix: Hide navigation and controls; deny token management pages/streams and forced browser token/session commands. Both manual forced commands returned 403. Typed Current User token/session APIs retain their existing principal-scoped authorization; this policy change covers the browser management portal.

issues.title: Users had no Data & sharing / Storage page
issues.problem: Storage navigation and its page were restricted to platform administrators.
issues.fix: Add a read-only user Storage page listing authorized Source, Model and Semantic model names/types only. Current credential attenuation and project binding remain enforced. Physical tables, schemas, counts and operational statistics stay administrator-only.

issues.title: Chat sidebar lacked quick rename
issues.problem: The sidebar had Pin, Archive and Delete but no hover Rename or double-click rename.
issues.fix: Add Rename to hover/focus/touch actions and double-click titles; briefly defer desktop single-click navigation. Focus/select the existing name. Saved name survived reload; original local chat name restored afterwards.

issues.title: Popularity tooltip spilled over the table
issues.problem: Long popularity help was unwrapped and could be clipped by table scrolling.
issues.fix: Use a bounded top-layer anchored popover with wrapped text, keyboard focus and tap support. Escape/outside pointer dismiss it. Desktop, dark and narrow viewport evidence included.

issues.title: Agent stopped at dashboard metadata for a metric explanation
issues.problem: The supplied recording shows an answer listing dashboard metadata and asking permission to inspect the metric instead of completing necessary authorized reads.
issues.fix: Strengthen the default system prompt to resolve returned semantic-model references, inspect the definition and dependencies in the same turn, and distinguish permission denial from missing evidence. Avoid unsupported calculation claims and internal metadata boilerplate.

issues.title: Data Explorer availability depends on permissions
issues.problem: The supplied feedback reports Explorer unavailable to a user. Viewer and Explorer have different access; missing Explorer permission cannot safely be replaced by self-granting it.
issues.fix: Earlier PR fixes expose governed semantic datasets to approved Explorers. Current local Explorer shows nine semantic datasets. No silent Viewer upgrade or self-grant path was added.
issues.status: Approved Explorer behavior confirmed; original production user permissions unverified

originalAuditHistory.firstProblem: Originally, granting or removing a role changed Last activity to Never and emptied session/activity lists until reload.
originalAuditHistory.fixAndEvidence: The response now preserves the selected user, group or service account when refreshing details. Grant and removal were observed without losing existing sessions or activity.

originalAuditHistory.title: An existing live stream survived session revocation
originalAuditHistory.firstProblem: Fresh requests were rejected after admin revocation, but an already-open chat stream continued receiving keepalives. New sensitive-data leakage was not demonstrated.
originalAuditHistory.fixAndEvidence: Authenticated streams recheck credentials and account state before writes and every five seconds while idle. On the final build the populated stream closed in 4.961 seconds; fresh requests returned 401 and no additional bytes arrived. Blocking also closed a monitored stream in 4.674 seconds during earlier verification.

originalAuditHistory.title: Revoke all sessions omitted authoring/CLI sessions
originalAuditHistory.firstProblem: The command updated browser/desktop session storage while its message claimed all sessions were revoked. The omission was first found in source.
originalAuditHistory.fixAndEvidence: Bulk revocation now covers browser, desktop, authoring/CLI and OAuth sessions in one audited transaction. A temporary credential-free authoring fixture was manually verified as revoked and then deleted. OAuth coverage is included in code; an OAuth login flow was not manually exercised. API tokens keep their separate lifecycle.
